boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct study environments inside UConn’s Homer Babbidge Library, with official floor-map and reservation guidance.

cards.title: Settle into the Auriemma Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Plaza Level
cards.notes: Use the Plaza Level reading room for an on-site work session, then check the nearby iDesk if you need library help or directions.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room on the library’s main Plaza Level.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library’s Homer Babbidge floor map lists the Auriemma Reading Room on the Plaza Level.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Homer Babbidge Library. After 8 p.m., UConn ID access is required.

cards.title: Use the 24 Hour Study area
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Plaza Level
cards.notes: Plan a focused library session in the named 24 Hour Study area; bring your UConn ID for building access after the evening cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A designated around-the-clock study area on the Plaza Level.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library’s floor map lists “24 Hour Study” on the Plaza Level, and the library states UConn ID access is required after 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The library identifies a 24-hour study space; after 8 p.m., access requires a UConn ID.

cards.title: Work quietly on Level A
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Level A
cards.notes: Head to Level A when you want a designated quiet-study setting and easy proximity to the law, journals, and related collections.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area beside Level A collections.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library’s floor map identifies a Quiet Study Area on Level A and lists its surrounding subject collections.
cards.access_notes: Inside Homer Babbidge Library; after 8 p.m., UConn ID access is required.

cards.title: Choose the Level 2 Quiet Study Space
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Use this named Level 2 quiet space when your research needs to stay close to the library’s science and social-sciences collections.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet space on the science and social-sciences floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library’s floor map lists a Quiet Study Space on Level 2, where science and social-sciences collections are located.
cards.access_notes: Inside Homer Babbidge Library; after 8 p.m., UConn ID access is required.

cards.title: Take a quiet session to Level 4
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Level 4
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing work to the Level 4 quiet area, located alongside literature, psychology, religion, and oversize collections.
cards.short_summary: A quiet upper-floor area adjacent to humanities collections.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library’s floor map lists a Quiet Study Area on Level 4 and identifies its nearby literature, psychology, and religion collections.
cards.access_notes: Inside Homer Babbidge Library; after 8 p.m., UConn ID access is required.

cards.title: Find the Graduate Study Commons
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Locate the Graduate Study Commons on Level 3 when you need a named library workspace near education, geography, history, and law materials.
cards.short_summary: A named Level 3 study commons among social-science collections.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library’s floor map lists the Graduate Study Commons on Level 3.
cards.access_notes: Inside Homer Babbidge Library; after 8 p.m., UConn ID access is required.

cards.title: Reserve an Individual Study Room
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Level 3
cards.notes: Reserve a Level 3 individual room up to 24 hours ahead when you need a contained one- or two-person study setting.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms for one or two people.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library states that Individual Study Rooms are on Level 3, hold one to two people, and can be reserved up to 24 hours in advance for up to three hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Current UConn students reserve with a NetID; reservations open 24 hours ahead for up to three hours per day.

cards.title: Book a Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Levels B, 1, 2, 3, and 4
cards.notes: Reserve a group room for collaborative work, or use an unoccupied room until a group with a reservation asks to take it.
cards.short_summary: Reservable collaborative rooms distributed across five library levels.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library states that Group Study Rooms are on Levels B, 1, 2, 3, and 4; groups of two or more may reserve them up to three days in advance.
cards.source_title: Homer Babbidge Library Group Study Room Policy
cards.access_notes: For groups of two or more; reserve up to three days ahead. Unoccupied rooms may be used but must be yielded to a reservation.

cards.title: Claim a Babbidge Booth
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Levels B, Plaza, 1, 2, 3, and 4
cards.notes: Look for an open booth when you need a compact one- or two-person workspace; booths are available without a reservation.
cards.short_summary: First-come booths found throughout the library.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library states that Babbidge Booths are located on Levels B, Plaza, 1, 2, 3, and 4, serve one to two people, and are first come, first served.
cards.access_notes: First come, first served; located inside Homer Babbidge Library. After 8 p.m., UConn ID access is required.

cards.title: Read and work in the Leisure Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Homer Babbidge Library, Level B
cards.notes: Use the Level B Leisure Reading Room for a reading-based work block, then explore the adjacent leisure and government-documents areas if useful.
cards.short_summary: A named Level B reading room near leisure materials.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Library’s floor map lists the Leisure Reading Room on Level B.
cards.access_notes: Inside Homer Babbidge Library; after 8 p.m., UConn ID access is required.
